Both clips are for visitor-enabled playback. The recording is Czech.

| legend-scratch.mp3 | Synthesized vinyl cue with six gated forward and reverse moves, followed by a kick. | 1.672 s | 5f545647b8dbfe3f33457376b07f08479a110cede202d2a028c723cf4c319ffd |
| legend-rap-cs.mp3 | Original 88 BPM two-bar boom-bap arrangement under synthetic Czech spoken rap. | 6.087 s | 76859d2331359b5c434f36503f708cdbf04ecffd19071901043f3ebd3680f819 |

The DJ cue and rap instrumental were synthesized from oscillators and seeded noise. The vocal was generated in the AI Voice Generator deep style from the transcript below, cut into two phrases, and mixed locally with the instrumental. No third-party record samples were used.

> Na skle starej otisk, v krku novej hlas.  
> Tři doby držím já, tu čtvrtou nechám na vás.

The first vocal region is placed at 0.225 s and the second at 2.952 s in the pre-encode mix. Both masters are stereo MP3 at 44.1 kHz, decoded with FFmpeg, and measured with sample peaks of −1.5 dBFS.
